title: MAIRA-1
paper_title: MAIRA-1: A Specialised Large Multimodal Model for Radiology Report Generation
core_mech: MAIRA-1 不是通用图文预训练模型，而是冻结胸片 RAD-DINO、使用四层 adapter，并完整微调 Vicuna-7B 的专用报告生成器。
core_mech_en: Specialist chest X-ray report generator pairing a frozen CXR-specific RAD-DINO visual encoder, a 4-layer MLP adapter, and a fully fine-tuned Vicuna-7B LLM.
input_desc: 胸部 X 光图像及可选 indication 文本
input_en: Frontal chest X-ray + clinical indication/history prompt
output_desc: 放射报告 Findings 文本

source.title: MAIRA-1
notes: The Atlas paper and current Microsoft/Hugging Face searches did not establish an accessible MAIRA-1 release. MAIRA-2 is a different model and is not substituted. A paper-based implementation must state all unresolved details.

gaps: An accessible complete MAIRA-1 release was not established in the source audit. MAIRA-2 is a different model. Paper-only implementation details remain unresolved.
